🌴 Welcome to The Hampton Hotel!
by the Hampton Hospitality Company
*Please note this place is not completely finished! Work in progress*

Experience comfort, luxury, and great hospitality at The Hampton Hotel 

Select from a variety of stylish rooms and suites, or a penthouse!
Enjoy a swim in our sparkling pool, or take a walk through the garden on floor 2.
Move between floors using the fully working elevators.
Dine at The Tides Restaurant, offering wonderful food options.
Walk around and explore the hotel!

💼 Interested in joining our professional team?
• Join the Hampton Hospitality Company group: https://www.roblox.com/groups/2801548/Hampton-Hospitality-Company

• Apply at our Application Center: https://www.roblox.com/games/393177365/Hampton-Application-Center

• Attend a training session and begin your career in hospitality.

Enjoyed your stay?
Please like 👍 and favorite the game to show your support!
